decision_reason: The change has material or unclear service impact and requires operator approval.
supporting_reasons: Interfaces were enabled without IP or routing configurations, and a CLI syntax error occurred during the configuration application.

Enabling unconfigured interfaces may expose the network to unauthorized connections or unexpected state changes. The operational impact of the CLI error is uncertain without further command-line verification.
Changing interface addressing can affect directly connected reachability and routing adjacencies.
